summary: Iteration 62 — Agent OS Sprint 2 (Control Center UI + HubSpot connector + inbound webhook layer) end-to-end verified. Backend pytest: 16/16 GREEN on test_iteration62_agentos_sprint2.py plus 8/8 GREEN on Sprint-1 regression (test_agent_os_sprint1.py) — 24/24 total. Frontend: Super-Admin logged in, /admin?tab=agentos loads the Control Center with all 4 sub-tabs (Pods / Approvals / Runs / Audit+Webhooks). Connector badges correctly show STUBBED (hs-outbound) and NOT CONFIGURED (hs-webhook) with the 'HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN' helper text visible. Kill switch toggles OFF→ON→OFF with red-500 class flipping in ON state and toast fires. Pods grid renders all 7 pods (pod_a_prospecting … pod_g_reporting) with scope badges + Disable/Dispatch buttons. Dispatch on pod_a_prospecting succeeded — toast 'Dispatched — run 63fc35cd…'. Approvals panel + filter dropdown (pending/approved/rejected) works. Runs panel loaded 77 rows, drill-in click populates right pane. Audit panel two-column layout renders (audit log + Recent HubSpot webhooks — 2 queued events from pytest seed). Audit filter input accepts typing. Graceful degradation on HubSpot verified — connector delegates to Sprint-1 stub with the required warning log, webhook endpoint returns 503 when secret is blank, and no user-visible errors surface.
critical_code_review_comments: hubspot_webhooks.verify_signature() correctly returns False when secret is blank (fail-closed) — good.
HubspotConnector.__init__ instantiates a HubspotStub even when a real token is set. Harmless (2 dicts) but the stub is dead-code once configured; consider lazy-init inside the fallback branch.

AgentOSControlCenter.jsx is 548 lines — approaching the 700-line cap in code-review guidelines. Consider splitting the 4 sub-panels (Pods / Approvals / Runs / Audit+Webhooks) into their own files before adding more surface area in Sprint 3.

The webhook dedupe key format `{portalId}:{subscriptionId}:{eventId}` uses string 'unknown' when any field is missing (hubspot_webhooks.py L101-103). If HubSpot ever sends a batch where multiple events share missing eventId (e.g., malformed retry), they will collide on 'unknown:unknown:unknown' and be silently dropped. Consider hashing the raw event body when any of the three keys are missing.

hubspot_connector.py L79 — the delegate _stub is instantiated at connector construction time; if the token is added later at runtime the code still creates the stub (memory waste, not a bug). Fine to leave.
